narrative.overview: AudioBits pairs the energy of a music poster with an instrument you can play. Near-black and white frame violet, saturated blue and pink. Oversized condensed typography, full-bleed stages and collectible geometric sound covers make discovery expressive; precise tactile workbenches make adoption clear. Sound leads the spectacle, and the portable source stays within reach.  Showcase tokens and fonts stay scoped to `.foundation`. Documentation keeps stock-neutral Fumadocs surfaces, layout, typography, light/dark palettes and theme switching, with dark mode as the default. Existing docs logo and active accents retain their documentation palette.
keyCharacteristics: Void, Ink and neutral Graphite support vivid signal accents.
Self-hosted Big Shoulders Display headlines pair with Geist Mono UI and code.
Family-based SVG covers are static illustrations, distinct from live output.
Live waveform and lighting follow actual audio; extension and movement follow stage state.
Tactile controls, readable source panels and visible focus support the spectacle.

rules.name: The Signal Honesty Rule
rules.body: Color may identify a family or brand section at rest. A visual presented as live output must follow real samples; static cover art never claims that sound is playing.

dos: Do make sound the primary interaction and keep editable source easy to reach.
Do read shared palette values from CSS and reuse family artwork roles.
Do distinguish illustrated cover geometry from actual live audio output.
Do preserve gesture activation, release, cancellation, cleanup and visible focus.
Do reduce motion while keeping state and controls understandable.
donts: Don't animate a fake live waveform while the instrument is idle.
Don't add a second audio engine or analyser for hero decoration.
Don't duplicate direct stage gestures with competing control panels.
Don't turn the showcase into a generic card dashboard, glass UI or DAW.
Don't apply showcase fonts, motion or heavy visual effects to Fumadocs.
